evidence: Modifies `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` and `src/rpc/blockchain.h` to hold `cs_main` when reading `CBlockIndex` fields in `getblockheader`, `getchaintxstats`, and `dumptxoutset`.
rationale: Fixes data races in blockchain RPC handlers reading `CBlockIndex` fields without holding `cs_main`. Adding `cs_main` to these RPC methods impacts locking behavior and avoids undefined behavior under concurrent block downloads or AssumeUTXO syncing.
